This error led to confusion about the release year of the correct film.

After that, the WebSurfer correctly identified "Cinesound Varieties" as being released in 1934. So the mistake happened in the first search when WebSurfer didn't correctly disambiguate the search term, leading to a mix-up with another film titled "Se7en."

Therefore, the mistake was made by WebSurfer in step 1, as that was the first step where the incorrect result was provided.
